accepted_hypotheses: A fixed finite set of at least two distinct primes, p the least prime; all positive smooth integers including 1; every repeated LCM occurrence counted; exact strict-prefix normalization P_a/p.

claims.statement: Lemma 2: weighted-simplex interval discrepancy uniform in interval endpoints
Closed-cube continuity and multiplicative face identities
Theorem 3: a nondegenerate interval contained in the subsequential limit set on each fixed arithmetic progression
Corollary 4: quantitative {2,3,5} progression oscillation and ratio bound
Corollaries 5-6: polynomial, quasipolynomial, and finite-family arbitrary-selection obstructions

singleton_exception: For P={p}, R_P=p/(p-1) and X_a=1/(p-1); oscillation and finite-polynomial obstruction would be false. Candidate correctly excludes it.

independent_finite_checks.method: Independent cumulative smooth counts between prime-power events; literal running LCM enumeration; independent outward-rounded -log(1-z) series; no candidate code imported or run.
